subject: [PIPELINE TEST — DO NOT SEND] Gmail draft path verification
body_plain:
This is a mechanism test created by the link-building pipeline on 2026-09-21. It is addressed internally, NOT to a journalist, because no draft is approved to send yet.

It exists to verify three things: that a draft can be created at all, that From can be set to the timur@ Send-as alias, and that the body survives intact with the credential line exact and no confirmation flag in it.

Safe to delete. The pipeline cannot delete it — create is the only write it is permitted.

— Timur Alptunaer, MD, RN, EMT-T, FACEP, InHouse Wellness (inhousewellness.com)
_comment: Live read-back of the Gmail draft created 2026-09-21 to verify the path. Evidence, not a fixture.
